errors.helper: Battery query failed (see the Noctalia log)
errors.no_answer: Mouse did not answer (off or asleep)
errors.no_permission: No access to the Keychron receiver - udev rule missing?

hide_when_unavailable.description: Hide the widget once no current or remembered reading is left (mouse off for long, receiver unplugged).
hide_when_unavailable.label: Hide when unavailable

keep_last.description: While the mouse sleeps, keep showing its last reading (dimmed) for this many minutes. 0 turns this off.
keep_last.label: Keep last reading (minutes)

settings.poll_interval: How often the mouse is asked for its battery level. While charging or low, it is asked four times as often.

battery_glyph.description: Show a battery glyph with the fill level instead of the device glyph.
battery_glyph.label: Battery glyph

icon_only.description: Show only the battery glyph, without the percentage. The tooltip still has the details.
icon_only.label: Icon only

low_threshold.description: At or below this level the entry turns red and a notification is sent.
low_threshold.label: Low battery (%)

notify_full.description: Send a notification once the device is fully charged.
notify_full.label: Notify when full

notify_low.description: Send a notification once when the battery drops to the low threshold.
notify_low.label: Notify when low
